obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Primary text, filled CTA buttons, and dark UI surfaces — near-black chosen over pure #000 to soften contrast against white canvas

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page background, card surfaces, and button text — the primary canvas across all sections below the hero

cloud-gray.$description: Cloud Gray — Secondary card surfaces and section backgrounds — separates feature blocks from main canvas

sky-tint.$description: Sky Tint — Card box-shadow tint and subtle blue-toned surface — keeps elevation feeling atmospheric rather than gray

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body text, secondary copy, and muted borders — the dominant neutral for non-heading content

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary text and inactive border states — used for placeholder labels and disabled affordances

ink.$description: Ink — Heading color and strong dividers — slightly lighter than Obsidian for less severe emphasis

surgical-blue.$description: Surgical Blue — Icon strokes, mic glyph, waveform player, and small functional accents — the single chromatic note across the interface

sky-gradient.$description: Sky Gradient — Hero background — vertical wash from medium blue to near-white that establishes the medical-aspirational mood

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

open-runde.$description: Primary display and heading face — geometric humanist with tight tracking at large sizes; the -0.04em at 80px compresses the headline into a single confident block. Use for all headings, nav, and large text.

inter.$description: Secondary body and UI text — used for small labels, nav items, and inline links where a more neutral reading rhythm is needed. Pairs with Open Runde for hierarchy contrast.

the-doctor-freeversion.$description: Decorative handwritten/doctor's note face — used only in the Before/After card illustrations to evoke clinical handwriting. Not for functional UI text.

open-runde-semibold.$description: Open Runde Semibold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

open-runde-medium.$description: Open Runde Medium — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

open-runde-regular.$description: Open Runde Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

open-runde-bold.$description: Open Runde Bold — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
